recap.text: Princess Donut rides Gluteus Maxx's shoulder at the Penis Parade and showers gold coins into his thong. Katia reports Gluteus is a good dancer, a bit of a jerk, and possibly in love with the cat. Gluteus fights for the club with twin war gauntlets.

Gluteus Maxx drives heat three in a Speedo and a borrowed hockey helmet because Crawler Carl cannot reach the pedals in a kangaroo. Gluteus Maxx is the best stripper at Mario Kart. He took two outworlder uppers Samantha found in a snake guy's garbage pile, and his eyes are red at the line.

beats.headline: Princess Donut on his shoulder
beats.text: Sighting, the Penis Parade: Princess Donut on stage with Subject, riding his shoulder and showering gold coins into his thong. She had tried the Penis Palace on the middle floor, found it boring, and come up a floor. Crawler Li Na watched from the room, on Crawler Katia's instructions. Katia's assessment of Subject: a bit of a jerk, a good dancer, and possibly a little in love with the cat. Katia also reports that the cat keeps a strict budget in there.
beats.gist: Princess Donut rides Gluteus Maxx's shoulder at the Penis Parade and showers gold coins into his thong.

beats.headline: Short, fuzzy, and available
beats.text: Subject dances at the Penis Parade and, since the court took on the club’s people, fights for it: short, hairy, built like the job, and insistent on twin war gauntlets. Crawler Katia’s review, on file: a bit of a jerk, a good dancer, and a little in love with the cat.
beats.gist: Gluteus Maxx is a short, hairy mercenary and dancer who wants twin war gauntlets.

beats.headline: Two uppers, and the wheel
beats.text: Chosen to drive heat three because Crawler Carl cannot reach the pedals in a kangaroo and Gluteus Maxx is the best of the strippers at Mario Kart. He drives in a Speedo and a borrowed hockey helmet. At the line his eyes are red. Samantha found outworlder uppers in the garbage pile from the snake guy and says one before a race lets you taste time; it is how she wins at Mario Kart. He took two. It is too late to change drivers.
beats.gist: Gluteus Maxx drives heat three in a Speedo and borrowed hockey helmet because Carl cannot reach pedals.
